㐆.g: (corrupted form) to follow, to trust to; to put confidence in; to depend on, to turn around; to turn the body, (interchangeable 隱)

㐌.g: a tribe of savages in South China

㐬.g: (same as 旒; corrupted form of 荒) a cup with pendants, a pennant, wild, barren, uncultivated

㐭.g: (same as 廩) a granary, to supply (foodstuff), to stockpile

㒸.g: (same as 遂) to obey; to comply with; to follow the wishes of another, (an ancient form of 歲) a year, age, the harvest

㒼.g: average; equivalent; corresponding, to cover something carefully and tightly without a break; (Cant.) blocked

㓞.g: to engrave, (interchangeable 契) a written contract or agreement
